parsed.note_claim: C'est une fausse page captcha (technique ClickFix/TerminalFix) qui incite à exécuter des commandes PowerShell malveillantes pour installer des malwares.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Microsoft Threat Intelligence said a campaign it calls TerminalFix, a variant of the ClickFix technique, uses compromised websites to display a fake Cloudflare verification prompt.
parsed.reason: The article explicitly confirms the existence of the TerminalFix/ClickFix campaign using fake Cloudflare verification prompts to trick victims.
